name: Mallorca Preservation Foundation Grants
summary: Grants for local non-profits and other bodies running projects in Mallorca on biodiversity, marine conservation, ecological agriculture, sustainability and environmental education.

applicant_types.quote: Local non-profit organizations, associations, clubs or unions, social cooperative enterprises and/or other local bodies, including research centers, are highly recommended to apply for grants.

geography.quote: The MAPF encourages the implementation of projects in Mallorca.

access.quote: All applicants need to complete and send our application form.
